front.how: two set things stand where people are drawn: the chairs and the table. Each item of the sorted list owns the pixels it drew last; at the chairs' entry (sortY 60: after whoever is behind the table, drawn at 40 + y / 100, and before anyone else) and at the table's (the old table's own place, TZ 173, comer.js:552) their pixels are drawn again over each item drawn before that owns them, only where that pixel is nearer to the camera than the item: bakedZ[i] > v / COS - (row + .5 - OY) * tan(30 deg) / S, v = (x + y) / R2 of the floor point under the item's feet. "Behind the table" is that depth test, not a row: a seated one's lap under the table's far edge, whoever walks behind the chairs, the children at its back corners
